name: Hostwinds VPS
line: Rent a Linux virtual server with managed or unmanaged support.

cells.regions: Seattle, Dallas, Amsterdam; regional prices not listed

work.math: $4.99 a month includes 1 TB of bandwidth and one IPv4 address. 100 GB fits. The domain and outside CI are extra, before tax.
1 CPU and 1 GB, 30 GB SSD, 1 TB bandwidth: $7.14 a month, with no request meter. Throughput is untested, before tax.
$15.29 a month base (V2 plan $14.29 + backup $1) + $0.03 per GB of stored backup. The size depends on the data on the full server.
